name: Lizumerhof
beschreibung: The Lizumerhof is a hotel in the Wattental in the municipality of Navis, surrounded by the mountain world of the Tuxer Alpen. The amenities include a restaurant with regional cuisine as well as a wellness area with sauna and steam bath. The country-house-style furnishings shape the cozy atmosphere of the house. In summer, the hotel serves as a base for hikers and mountain bikers. In winter, ski tourers and cross-country skiers are the main target group. The quiet location away from the main traffic routes appeals to those seeking relaxation and families.
